note: findings refusals, from fixtures/relations. A provider ref is a ref of a kind findings does not take (invalid_ref); a register with named tables is not a table (table_is_register lists gammal and ny); an unknown ref is not_found; a malformed period is invalid_period naming the parameter; the bare name `lopnr` is shared by a variable of rel and one of kalla (ambiguous_ref lists both by fqid). Fails if a provider ref answers a list, if `table` takes a register with named tables, if a bad period is ignored, or if a shared bare name picks one entity.
